questions.question: Where will people get the link to the main page?
questions.why: Visitors may start from search, an invite, or a link you send.

questions.question: Which pages should someone see before signing in?
questions.why: This draws the line between public and private pages.

questions.question: Where should a person end up after finishing the main task?
questions.why: The site needs a clear next step.

exit_criteria: Name each primary page, its users, and its entry point.

questions.question: What will a visitor type in or upload?
questions.why: The site only needs information it will actually use.

questions.question: Can several people share one account or view the same records?
questions.why: Shared access changes what each person may see.

questions.question: How should a person ask you to remove their information?
questions.why: The plan needs a way to act on a deletion request.

exit_criteria: Record what public forms keep, who may see it, and when to delete it.

questions.question: Which screen should work best first, a phone or a computer?
questions.why: This sets the order for design and checks.

questions.question: What should the first visitor see when the site has no records?
questions.why: An empty page needs a useful next step.

questions.question: What should happen if the connection drops while someone submits a form?
questions.why: A retry should keep the work and avoid duplicates.

exit_criteria: Describe mobile and desktop flows, empty states, and recovery from a broken connection.

questions.question: Do you already have somewhere to host the site or need help choosing?
questions.why: The plan should fit what you can maintain.

questions.question: Will the site use a web address you already own?
questions.why: Someone needs control of the address and its renewal.

questions.question: Who should find out first if the site stops loading?
questions.why: The plan needs a responsible person and a way to reach them.

exit_criteria: Confirm host, site address and owner for uptime and renewal.
